title: perf-benchmarking-sync-2026-04-21
content:
Performance & Benchmarking Sync - 2026-04-21
Owner: Aisha Patel
Attendees: Aisha Patel, Ethan Chen, Maya Rodriguez, Diego Alvarez, Priya Singh (SRE)
Duration: 45m

Agenda:
- Quick recap of last week's rolling canary and observed regressions
- Repro runs and metrics (p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec)
- Hypotheses (kernel changes, quantization tweaks, scheduling)
- Action items and next tests

Summary / TL;DR:
- We observed a latency regression on short-sequence generation workloads (prompt len ~16) across Dedicated pools after rolling PR #1864. p95 increased from ~110ms -> ~210ms on A100-backed nodes under steady load. Throughput for large-batch workloads dropped ~20% in tokens/sec.
- Repro is stable in our perf harness; root-cause narrowed to kernel selection path that changed fallback behavior when KV-cache reused across requests. Probable interaction with recent CUDA cuBLAS update on images.

Details / Notes:
1) Repro runs (baseline = last week stable snapshot v2026-04-14):
   - perf-run-id: perf-run-2026-04-20-01 (A100 40GB, batch_size=1, seq=64):
     * baseline (v2026-04-14): p50=35ms, p95=110ms, p99=215ms, tokens/sec=5,200
     * current (post-PR):    p50=48ms, p95=210ms, p99=420ms, tokens/sec=4,100
   - perf-run-id: perf-run-2026-04-20-02 (H100, batch_size=4, seq=512):
     * baseline: p50=320ms, p95=760ms, tokens/sec=22,000
     * current:  p50=340ms, p95=820ms, tokens/sec=17,500
   - KV-cache hit-rate on short seq sim: dropped from ~88% -> ~72% in current runs (possible invalidation/regeneration pattern)

2) What changed recently:
   - PR #1864 merged last Thursday: refactor kernel selector + small latency optimization for long sequences. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1864
   - Infra image bumped cuBLAS/cuDNN minor versions in dedicated images on Friday (image: redwood-infer/a100-runtime:2026-04-17)
   - Canary rollout targeted several Dedicated pools (eu-west and us-central) over weekend

3) Hypotheses discussed:
   - H1: Kernel selector regression (fallback path triggered incorrectly for short seqs) causing extra matmul overhead and memory ops. Strong signal: correlation with PR #1864 code paths.
   - H2: cuBLAS minor version combined with codepath changed FP/math op ordering, exposing a faster path for long seqs but slower for short batched items.
   - H3: KV-cache invalidation edge-case: new scheduler timing causes cache misses across closely spaced requests (race), reducing effective cache hit rate.

4) Tests run / planned:
   - Reproduced locally with perf harness (Ethan). Run matrix: A100/H100, batch sizes 1/4/8, quantized and fp16, seq=16/64/512.
   - Quick experiment: revert kernel selector change on a single canary host -> preliminary runs show p95 back to ~120ms (promising).
   - QA to run delta builds: (a) image w/old cuBLAS + new runtime; (b) new cuBLAS + reverted selector; (c) new selector + add explicit KV-cache lock to test race.

5) Impact / Severity:
   - Customer-facing impact: limited but visible for low-latency endpoints (chat UX stutter). Several Dedicated customers reported higher tail latency NPS hits. No increased error rate observed.
   - Business: prioritize rollback / mitigation for Dedicated pools with strict SLOs. Hosted API customers less impacted due to different runtime config and autoscaling cushion.

6) Immediate actions (owners & due dates):
   - Aisha: coordinate targeted rollback of PR #1864 on eu-west dedicated pool. ETA: 2026-04-22 EOD.
   - Ethan: produce a delta perf report comparing (baseline / current / selector-revert) with raw logs and flamegraphs. ETA: 2026-04-22 12:00 PDT. Linked artifact: JIRA-PERF-412.
   - Maya: run cuBLAS/version isolation matrix on infra images and report interactions (A100/H100). ETA: 2026-04-23.
   - Diego: add a KV-cache instrumentation flag to count invalidations and races; schedule canary with flag enabled on a small pool. ETA: 2026-04-24.
   - Priya (SRE): hold capacity / add temporary autoscale buffer for impacted Dedicated pools while mitigation in progress. ETA: 2026-04-22.

Open questions / Notes to self:
- Do we have a clear test that isolates selector logic from BLAS performance? Need microbench harness for small-matrix matmul path.
- Consider hotfix: detect short-seq path and force previous kernel policy as temporary guard. Low-risk but needs careful perf validation.
- Need to add a regression test to CI that runs a short-sequence latency profile on PRs touching selector.

Decisions made:
- Rollback PR #1864 on highest-traffic Dedicated pools as a stopgap while we validate root cause.
- Postmortem to be compiled after we validate cause and final fix (owners: Aisha + Ethan). Target date for postmortem: 2026-04-30.

Next sync:
- Weekly perf sync 2026-04-28 10:00 PT. Quick check-in channel: #perf-alerts (Slack).

Appendix: quick log snippets
- perf-run-2026-04-20-01 summary: "p95 jump coincides with selector branch entering fallback_matmul_v2 - extra memcpy observed in timeline"
- repro command: ./perf_harness --model gpt-small --device a100 --batch 1 --seq 64 --runs 100 --snapshot v2026-04-14
